# GoXL Ally

> GoXL Ally is an AI "Founder's Compass" for entrepreneurs, made by GoXL Entrepreneurship (India). It runs an adaptive diagnosis of the founder, the business and the current situation, writes a Clarity Report that surfaces the constraint most worth addressing first, and then helps the founder decide and act on what to do next.

## What it does

- Adaptive diagnosis: about 20 minutes of questions on how the founder decides and works, the current problem, and the business itself.
- Clarity Report: generated in seconds when the diagnosis finishes; surfaces the constraint most worth addressing first, rather than the symptom.
- Talk to Ally: ongoing chat, with voice, that already knows the founder's context.
- Next 3 steps, Goals, Plan Your Day: turns the diagnosis into a sequence of actions and a daily habit.
- Discovery call: 30 minutes with a GoXL advisor who has read the report, ₹300 on any plan.

## Who it is for

Founders running a real business who know something is off but not what. Most useful once there are customers and momentum and the question is where to put the next month of effort.

## Plans (INR)

- Starter: ₹199 one-time payment. One adaptive diagnosis and your Clarity Report
- Plus: ₹499 per month. For founders working on the business weekly
- Pro: ₹999 per month. Ally as your standing advisor

## How to get access

Register at https://www.goxlally.ai/ (name and email). Access opens in batches: the first registrations are let in immediately, later ones join a queue and are told their place in line, and everyone gets an email with a sign-in link when their place opens. The product itself is at https://app.goxlally.ai/ and is only for founders who have been let in.
